breakage_notes: Concurrency Evaluation (5 Parallel Celesto Sandboxes): Monitored per-guest CPU allocation, memory isolation, and network sockets across 5 simultaneous microVM instances. On Celesto Cloud free trial, concurrent quotas enforce a ceiling of 1 retained active microVM (HTTP 429 quota reached on sandbox 2), requiring strict serialization or quota top-up. On local Firecracker/Linux runtime, running 5 concurrent microVMs succeeded with zero memory bleed or port collisions, maintaining strict hardware virtualization isolation.
